recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Future SupplyRequest/SupplyDelivery terminology status work belongs in HL7/oo-incubator; no specific external follow-up is needed for FHIR-44643 because the OO incubator package already has the affected ValueSets and CodeSystems as active.
issue_request: FHIR-44643 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification. It asked that SupplyDelivery-status, SupplyDelivery-SupplyItemType, and SupplyRequest-status terminology be active; the resolution said to update the ValueSets to active and described the CodeSystems as already intended/listed as active.
initial_application: Commit e73a8f7f845cfcd4ceb4ae70797dd44a0f735397 applied FHIR-44643 by changing source/supplydelivery/valueset-supplydelivery-status.xml, source/supplydelivery/valueset-supplydelivery-supplyitemtype.xml, and source/supplyrequest/valueset-supplyrequest-status.xml from draft to active. The corresponding historical core CodeSystem files still say draft, but those files no longer feed the active core build.
additional_context: Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed supplyrequest and supplydelivery from active source/fhir.ini resource registration and redirected current references to the HL7 OO incubator. The current OO incubator package contains ValueSet and CodeSystem resources for supplydelivery-status, supplydelivery-supplyitemtype, and supplyrequest-status, and all six have status active. OO 2024-03-01 minutes record the persuasive-with-modification vote, and no contradictory Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. Editing the stale FHIR-core CodeSystem source would change inactive files rather than the current built specification, while the current external owner already reflects the requested active statuses.
